Una aplicación de escritorio libre para: A free desktop app for fluid simulation with OpenFOAM built in: from geometry to 3D post-processing without touching the terminal or installing anything else.
Geometría, malla, física, ejecución supe: Geometry, mesh, physics, supervised run and post-processing in a single app, with each stage's tools always in the same place.
Los instaladores incluyen OpenFOAM, MPI: The installers include OpenFOAM, MPI and the mesher (Python and Gmsh). There is nothing else to install or configure.
Flujo incompresible laminar, transitorio: Incompressible laminar flow, transient or steady, and steady k-ω SST turbulence with wall functions.
Inspecciona modelos, mallas y resultados: Inspect models, meshes and results with VTK without leaving the interface, with contours, profiles and reports.
Tres casos se ejecutan con OpenFOAM real: Three cases run with real OpenFOAM and are compared against their reference: Poiseuille, the Ghia cavity and a turbulent flat plate.
AppImage probada en nueve distribuciones: AppImage tested on nine Linux distributions and DMG for macOS, each with its SHA-256 checksum.
Vortia es experimental. Sus capacidades: Vortia is experimental. Its capabilities evolve with each release and results require validation before any critical engineering use. The verified cases are numerical checks, not validation of a design.
